queries.name: bronze.crm_client.client_id.duplicate_count
queries.sql:
WITH frequencies AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS frequency
    FROM crm_client
    WHERE client_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY client_id)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frequencies
WHERE frequency > 1
